en.metaDescription: Marketplaces, logistics, and payment platforms. Live demos on cross-border compliance and fulfilment from both corridors. São Paulo, 5–7 February 2026.

cn.metaTitle: 巴西–中国跨境贸易博览会 | LATAM China Tech
